description.narrative: Provision of a senior secured loan to Addiko Bank dd Sarajevo ("ABSA") of EUR 3 million under the Financial Intermediaries Framework ("FIF") for on-lending to small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The proposed project will improve access to finance for SMEs, which are the main source of employment in the private sector and a major contributor to the economy in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The bank is successfully implementing a SME-focused strategy and well-positioned to provide much needed financing to smaller businesses in the country via its regional branch network. The focus will also be on lending in the regions outside the capital and attracting new SME clients. In addition, the project will help in the rollout of the Business Academy to boost the management capacity of SMEs across the country.
